Introduction & Setplay.Cammy Setplay: The above unfortunately has lost a lot of it's spice now. Capcom changed it so the cancel window is 2 frames later now which has lowered the advantage of her Hooligan play. It's a lot harder to overhead now and it can never be drive reversal safe. Introduction & Setplay.Cammy Setplay: Never fear though, we have new setplay! It's not as easy to route into as stHP > HK, but the oppurtunities arise often. I'm going to cover both setups one by one and the options that follow. All of these will be followed up with Charged Hooligan and they work midscreen or corner.

Introduction & Setplay.Unnamed: 3: bMP > HK, DR stLK xx L Knuckle

Here's the big question...How do we route into these? bMP can be done from stLP, a divekick, a jump in, even DRC routes but this would mean you've now spent 4 bars and I personally don't think that's good business with how important Drive is in this game. Is it worth it in this route? Absolutely. It's auto-timed for the overhead, but manually timed for the grab so you'll need to practice this. 

Moving onto bHK, this is a little more complicated when jump ins are involved because you need to confirm your opponent is standing. If it's after a fireball then it's easy but other situations may be harder. There's no easy way to solve this without spending meter and if you're not sure then you can just go for the bMP route.
Routing into this from a DRC though is simple. DRC crHP, bHK. The reason for the crHP here is to force stand. This route followed up with L Knuckle is 1856 damage, whereas her most damage midscreen combo from crMK DRC is 2101 so you're not giving up a great deal for a mix. 
Another simple way to route into this is counter-hit crHP, or punish counter crHP. I'm not going to cover all the damage options here, but I personally think we're giving up a lot of damage when from a PC we only need to spend 1 bar to get 3100 damage.

Set CPU to OD Reversal on Block - Count 1
crMK DRC, if the opponent blocks then you press stLP to jail, then reset.
crMK DRC, if the opponent is hit, you press stMP, crHP, crMP xx H Arrow
Set CPU to Random Counter (turn off Punish Counter)
Press stMP. On block, or regular hit, do nothing.
Press stMP. On Counter-Hit, press stHP > HK xx L/M Arrow

The Big One - Set Play Practice.
We're using this to practice 2 Hit Confirms, Perfect Parry, Meaties, and counter-hit, regular hit and block situations following meaties.
Setup :
Set CPU to Block All
Set Block Reversal - 4f - Count 1
Set Block Reversal - Do Nothing - Count 1
Set Wake Up Reversal - 4f
Set Wake up Reversal - Do Nothing
Set Wake up Reversal - Forward Jump
Actions :

Start in the corner and perform your light string (crLK, crLP, stLP / crLP, crLP, stLP / Whatever ). If you see a hit on the second button this means you're going to finish the string and cancel into M Arrow, if you do not see a hit on the second button then finish your string but do NOT cancel into M Arrow, instead perform Medium Dive Kick, you're going to be minus here and can then press parry to practice the perfect parry timing after a dive kick (yes this loses to a throw but it's rare here due to the spacing).

Going back to the light string, should that hit and you do perform M Arrow, you are then following up with dash, crHP. If crHP hits regular then do crMP, H Arrow. If crHP hits counter-hit then do stHP, H Arrow. After the arrow, you dash, crHP. If this hits either regular or CH, then you perform stHP, H Arrow. This works different because after H Arrow, dash crHP hits meaty making you +3 on block. Whereas after M Arrow, you can only get +1.
